response.sql:
WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    sm.zoneref,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(CAST(sm.facetfaces AS REAL)) as site_avg_faces
  FROM scanmesh sm
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sm.zoneref, s.entrystat
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(sm.facetfaces AS REAL)) as baseline_avg
  FROM scanmesh sm
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.entrystat,
    AVG(sa.site_avg_faces) as status_avg
  FROM site_averages sa
  WHERE sa.entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sa.entrystat
),
filtered_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.site_avg_faces,
    sta.status_avg,
    b.baseline_avg
  FROM site_averages sa
  JOIN status_averages sta ON sa.entrystat = sta.entrystat
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE sa.site_avg_faces > sta.status_avg
    AND b.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  AVG(site_avg_faces) as avg_kept_sites,
  AVG(site_avg_faces - baseline_avg) as avg_diff_from_baseline,
  AVG(site_avg_faces - status_avg) as avg_diff_from_status
FROM filtered_sites;

assumptions.assumption: Missing facetfaces values (NULL) are excluded from all average calculations, including the baseline.

The baseline is computed from all individual facetfaces values across all matched scanmesh records, regardless of site access status. If baseline is NULL, the result returns one row with three NULL values rather than zero rows.
Each site is identified uniquely by zoneref; multiple scanmesh records may exist per site and contribute to that site's average.
